long_term.advice: The long-run signs are weak right now: keep the small regular buys, but avoid one big purchase now.

long_term.why: Because the long wave is down (below the 200-day average).

evidence.test: at or below the average: +1 (cheap for the long run) | 30%+ above: -1 (far above)
fell 10%+: +1 | rose 30%+: -1 (a fast run-up often cools)
above: +1 (the long wave is up) | below: -1
evidence.why: on such days the next year was +13% vs +24% usually - agrees, counts

long_term.record_line: Past GO SLOW days: 1 year later +13% on average (higher on 94%) vs +24% for any day (higher on 89%).
long_term.note: Graded on the price 1 year later over about 6 years. Those years overlap (about one independent result per year), and the rules were switched on/off using the same years, so read it as a guide, not proof.

forecast_reason.summary: Expected to fall about 5.3% in 30 days. Biggest reason: recent trend (-6.8%).
forecast_reason.telugu: 30 రోజుల్లో సుమారు 5.3% తగ్గవచ్చు. ప్రధాన కారణం: ఇటీవలి ధోరణి (-6.8%).

drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 10.1% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 0.8% higher in 30 days' time (Dec) than now (Nov).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is below the last 5 days' average, and the forecast counts a one-day dip only half, so it starts 0.8% higher than today.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -12.2% to +3.5% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 5.4% on average at 30 days, vs 5.5% for "price stays the same" - it adds a little value. Direction right 69% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.

rules.english:
2026-11-22 Gold - HOLD (score 0 of 6): If buying: Don't add at today's price - buy only for a real need (a wedding, a gift).  If holding: Keep holding - the outlook beats what the money would earn in the bank.
Why: Mainly because prices usually rise in the next two months and it fell very fast, and such falls often bounce back. Against it: the 30-day forecast doesn't beat the holding cost.
What would change it: Turns SELL if the price rises to Rs 1,15,728 (+2.5%). Stays HOLD even if it falls 15%.
How sure: Low. Past HOLD days (323 since 2017): higher 30 days later on 79% vs 61% of all days -> edge +18 points.
Price: Rs 1,12,905 per 10 g (Rs 1,16,292 with 3% GST); 7 days -9.3%, 30 days -12.7%. 30-day outlook Rs 1,06,887 (likely Rs 99,166 - Rs 1,16,908).
Saving for years: GO SLOW - The long-run signs are weak right now: keep the small regular buys, but avoid one big purchase now. Because the long wave is down (below the 200-day average).
rules.telugu:
2026-11-22 బంగారం - నిల్వ ఉంచండి (స్కోరు 0 / 6)
ఎందుకు: ముఖ్య కారణం: రాబోయే రెండు నెలల్లో ధరలు సాధారణంగా పెరుగుతాయి మరియు చాలా వేగంగా పడిపోయింది, ఇలాంటప్పుడు తరచుగా మళ్ళీ పెరుగుతుంది. వ్యతిరేకంగా: 30 రోజుల అంచనా నిల్వ ఖర్చును కూడా దాటడం లేదు.
ఏది మారిస్తే మారుతుంది: ధర Rs 1,15,728 (+2.5%) కి పెరిగితే అమ్మండి. ధర 15% తగ్గినా ఇదే సూచన.
నమ్మకం: తక్కువ. గతంలో HOLD రోజుల్లో (323 రోజులు) 30 రోజుల తర్వాత 79% సార్లు ధర పెరిగింది; ఏ రోజైనా 61% (తేడా +18).
ధర: 10 గ్రాములకు Rs 1,12,905 (GST తో Rs 1,16,292); 7 రోజుల్లో -9.3%, 30 రోజుల్లో -12.7%. 30 రోజుల అంచనా Rs 1,06,887 (Rs 99,166 - Rs 1,16,908).
ఏళ్ల తరబడి దాచుకునేవారికి: నెమ్మదిగా కొనండి - దీర్ఘకాల సంకేతాలు ఇప్పుడు బలహీనంగా ఉన్నాయి: చిన్న క్రమమైన కొనుగోళ్లు కొనసాగించండి, ఇప్పుడు ఒకేసారి పెద్ద మొత్తం కొనకండి. కారణం: దీర్ఘకాల ధోరణి కిందికి ఉంది (200 రోజుల సగటు కింద).
